definitions.reported_rho: |A| / quoted u; descriptive amplitude/error ratio, not a p-value.
definitions.same_estimator: H=(X^T W X)^-1 X^T W calculated by QR; fixed remainder handled before H y.
definitions.white_noise_covariance: diag(alpha²/n_k); alpha=540 in units of 1e-18 sqrt(s).
definitions.period_noise_covariance: diag(sigma_k²) from frozen primary rows; no extra residual scale.
definitions.eta_actual: alpha/(q sqrt(T) uwhite), q²=sum(n_k s_k²)/T; estimator losses are included.
definitions.time_scaling: For assumed coherent signal and independent white noise only: rho=|A| q eta sqrt(T)/alpha, a=1,b=1/2 at fixed q and eta.
definitions.T: sum of retained nominal one-second members, no >=2 day selection; all window effects remain in eta.
definitions.legacy: Triangular estimates give reported ratios only; no invented sampling/estimator to predict their errors.

legacy_triangular.scope: Author-reported rounded values transcribed into reported table; no estimator reconstruction.

results_library/signal_to_noise/RESULTS..randomness: None: algebraic propagation and finite-design fits, no simulation or fitted coherence exponent.

constituent_snr/results/RESULTS.json.model: raw y = M2 cos/sin + S2 cos/sin + N2 cos/sin + K2 cos/sin + 54 offsets; all free, equal fit weights.
constituent_snr/results/RESULTS.json.fit_weighting: Equal. Period noise changes propagated covariance only, not fitted coefficients or H.

noise_models.actual_period_noise: diag(sigma_k²) from existing period-dependent sigma; assumes independent bin errors, propagated H Sigma H^T.
noise_models.common_alpha540_white: diag(540²/n_k), alpha corresponds to about5.4e-16 sqrt(s).
noise_models.existing_scaled_LS: Existing residual-scaled LS covariance, independently reproduced.
noise_models.existing_UTC_day_jackknife: Existing covariance of four joint coefficients, independently reproduced by 43 deletions.

constituent_snr/results/RESULTS.json.scalar_definition: A=hypot(beta_cos,beta_sin); J=(beta_cos,beta_sin)/A; uA=sqrt(J C_pair J^T); rho=A/uA.
constituent_snr/results/RESULTS.json.operator_definition: h_A=J H_pair; actual period noise uA²=sum(h_A,k² sigma_k²).
constituent_snr/results/RESULTS.json.interpretation: Measured-phase local linearization, especially approximate at low S2 SNR; not a nonlinear amplitude CI, p-value or independent detection significance.
